title: Sydney Terror Attack Response
body: Rabbi Yehoram Ulman delivered a stirring message of resolve and unity after the Sydney terror attack that killed 15 people, including his son-in-law Rabbi Eli Schlanger. He broke down in tears and recited "Baruch dayan haemes" during Shacharis.

title: Ger Rosh Yeshiva Celebrates Chanukah
body: Rav Shaul Alter, the Gerer Rosh Yeshiva, marks the first night of Chanukah in a special video.
